children: on Wednesday announced new AI tools for customers and Dashers, alongside a drone delivery system, expanding the use of artificial intelligence across its ordering and delivery operations.
The San Francisco-based company said U.S. customers can join a beta program to place DoorDash

orders by text, with the service able to search restaurants, build carts, and complete checkout based on customer preferences. It said users of its Ask DoorDash assistant have discovered more than 40,000 new restaurants since its launch three months ago, while nearly half of restaurant orders through the service went to local spots those customers had not previously tried.
also launched a connector that allows companies to link its ordering service with internal AI tools or agents. The connector can find items, build carts, place orders, and track deliveries. SpaceXAI
, Vercel, Cognition, Tempo, and Mercor are among early beta partners.

Separately, the company launched DashBuddy, an AI assistant available through SMS in the U.S. and Canada to answer questions for new Dashers. More than 200,000 Dashers had used the tool as of September, and it resolved about 95% of questions from Dashers signing up or preparing for their first dash, based on internal data.
The delivery platform also unveiled a purpose-built autonomous aircraft and said pilot drone deliveries will begin in Northern California with Chipotle Mexican Grill

title: DoorDash broadens AI ordering tools, unveils drone delivery plans
